candidate_facts.candidate_value: Serious reactions: 27/30 (90%); deaths: 2/30 (7%); at least one life-threatening reaction: 8/30 (27%); at least one severe reaction: 26/30 (87%). Both deaths occurred while participants were using immunosuppression.
candidate_facts.endpoint_timing: Through each subject's last follow-up; two deaths reported 1.6 and 9.7 years after first infusion.
candidate_facts.limitation: Retain unfavorable events and variable observation windows; no event-rate comparison.
